caption:
If Module 2 feels harder, are you failing?

That's a myth. Module 2 is harder or easier based on how you did on Module 1. Harder means Module 1 went well.

Send this to a friend taking the SAT.
tiktok_caption: If Module 2 feels harder, are you failing? No. That's a good sign.

youtube.title: Harder Module 2 on the SAT? Good Sign
youtube.description: The digital SAT adapts by module: a harder second module means you did well on the first.
